summary: Implement provider-neutral, money-safe Price and exact InventoryPosition domains with minimal Warehouse identity, optimistic concurrency, transactional audit + outbox intents, exact Decimal persistence, and tenant/RLS safeguards without leaking provider-specific price/stock fields into Core.

impacts.evidence: Price, Warehouse, and InventoryPosition carry organization/workspace ownership, composite tenant foreign keys, forced RLS, and tenant-scoped repository transactions.
Price/inventory events and audit summaries contain business-operational values only and avoid customer PII, credentials, provider payloads, and full catalog descriptions.

Draft 2020-12 canonical Price, Warehouse, and InventoryPosition schemas establish exact Money/Quantity wire shapes before Task 006/API expansion; adapters map self-contained Core value objects into the shared Task-076a transport primitives.
Versioned price, warehouse, and inventory-position events are registered; every mutation persists event intent through Task-008 Transactional Outbox in the same SQL transaction.
Core Price/Inventory references canonical Offer/Warehouse only. No provider price/stock IDs or provider-specific branching is introduced.
Atomic high-risk expand migration 000010 creates exact price/inventory storage, tenant FKs, lifecycle guards, forced RLS, and immutable/versioned state without rewriting earlier tables.

Non-negative money/quantities, reserved<=on-hand, immutable identities, parent lifecycle checks, bounded identifiers, forced RLS, and hard-delete blockers fail closed against malformed or cross-tenant state.
Task 005 records canonical operational state but does not authorize sensitive external publication; Task 017 remains the external-write approval boundary.
Every mutation requires a distinct AuditID and appends a Task-003 immutable audit record in the same transaction as the state change and outbox event.
Optimistic versions prevent lost updates; exact values and stable Offer/Warehouse identity provide deterministic price/stock reconciliation inputs for Tasks 013/014.
No webhook surface is introduced; downstream egress consumes versioned canonical events.
Versioned price/inventory events plus bounded audit summaries expose deterministic mutation and contention/error signals without logging secrets.
Migration 000010 is additive. Rollback disables Task-005 writers while retaining price/inventory, audit, and outbox history; backup/restore rehearsal is extended.

Unit tests cover exact Money/Quantity invariants and adapter conversion to Task-076a wire primitives; migration/repository tests verify exact storage, RLS, atomic audit/outbox intent, contracts, tenancy isolation and restore rehearsal paths.
